newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat to invest $1 billion in India.
newsitem.headline: Fiat to invest $1 billion in India.

text.p: Italian car group Fiat plans to invest $1 billion in a number of ventures in India over the next five years, a spokesman for the company said on Wednesday.
Fiat's managing director Paolo Cantarella unveiled the plans on a visit to India this week which were reported in an interview with the Economic Times of India newspaper.

The main project is for Fiat to invest in a joint venture with India carmaker Premier Automobiles Ltd to manufacture 100,000 Palio cars a year. The Palio is Fiat's "world car" model which went into production in Brazil earlier this year.
Fiat will take a majority stake in the car venture, and this investment in India will follow the launch of Fiat's Uno small car on the Indian market last year.
Other projects involve Fiat offshoot Teksid examining a project to set up a joint venture steel foundry with 700,000 tonnes capacity.
